messages:
Priya (CS): FYI Acme reported a breaking change after this morning's canary — their ingestion which expects a top-level JSON object now gets a base64 string in the 'payload' field. parser is failing in prod.

Priya (CS): customer says this started right after we flipped the structured-output flag to v2 at 07:12. They sent an example: 
```
Request body: { \"prompt\": \"...\" }
Response from our API (expected): { \"payload\": { \"billing_info\": {...}, \"shipment\": {...} } }
Response they actually received: { \"payload\": \"eyJiaWxsaW5nX2luZm8iOiB7Li4ufQ==\" } // base64 of JSON
```

Priya (CS): Their downstream parser tries JSON.parse(payload) and gets: 
``Error: Unexpected token e in JSON at position 0`` (because payload is a base64 string)

Jonah (Eng): marking this high priority. Can you paste the exact request (headers + model param) that produced that response? Also which model variant and rollout config?

Priya (CS): curl they ran: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-structured-2026-v2","input":"invoice -> JSON: include billing_info, shipment"}'
```
They said the API returned the base64 payload only for a small % of requests (random sampling).

Liza (SRE): DeployerBot shows a canary called `structured-output-strictness-v2` rolled to 25% at 07:12:04 (config change id cfg-3344). There was also a micro-optimization in the packing layer earlier at 06:55. My first guess: envelope/serialization layer started encoding payloads for compact transport and one codepath forgot to decode before returning to user.

DeployerBot: Deployment record: cfg-3344 applied by @jonah at 07:12:04 -> rollout 25% -> models affected: redwood-structured-2026-v2.

Jonah (Eng): I can reproduce locally with a quick canary on the image. Running a small script now to compare kernel path where we apply `compact_serialize=true`. If confirmed we'll pause the rollout and revert cfg-3344.

Priya (CS): Customer is blocked, they asked for an immediate mitigation. Can we do a hotfix or toggle?

Jonah (Eng): Yes — pausing rollout now. If we see more than 1 report or automated monitoring shows increased parse errors we'll rollback. I'll also add a guard: if payload looks base64 (regex) decode it before returning for 24h.

Liza (SRE): I'm opening INC-2026 for tracking, assigning to Jonah. Need logs: correlate request ids from Acme (Priya can share request IDs). Also will add a short-term alert for schema-adherence regression (count of responses where `typeof payload === 'string'` for structured models).

Priya (CS): Sharing request ids privately and will update Acme that we're pausing rollout and investigating. Thanks everyone :pray:

Jonah (Eng): Plan: 1) pause cfg-3344 rollout (done) 2) hotfix decode-guard + test 3) rollback if hotfix can't be verified 4) postmortem on why serialization path bypassed decoder. Will post updates here.

Priya (CS): Customer acknowledged the pause and will resume testing once we confirm. I'll update the ticket with their logs and any repro samples they send.

Liza (SRE): Noted. Saving logs and will attach to INC-2026.

Jonah (Eng): Quick note: if anyone sees other customers with similar symptoms, ping this thread and add example responses.
